A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the results produced by real time deployment and simulation are not always similar and that the results produced by simulation are more reliable.
the results obtained by the simulation and the real deployment are different, but the differences are not large.
the results obtained from simulation are not accurate enough to be used as a benchmark to evaluate the performance of a wireless sensor network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
simulators should take into consideration the lower layers effects to provide accurate results.
simulators should be used as an aid to design and evaluate protocols but not as a substitute to the real world deployment.

the performance evaluation of MAC protocols in simulators can be used to guide and validate the design of MAC protocols, but the real deployment results are the only way to determine the performance of the MAC protocol.
